_comment: Example MCP registration for Claude Code. Merge the 'mcpServers' entry below into your Claude Code MCP config (e.g. `claude mcp add-json shinobi-recon '{...}'` or the equivalent in .claude/settings.json). shinobi agent already exports SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENT / SHINOBI_ENGAGEMENT_DIR before launching the agent, so the server inherits them — no extra env config needed when launched via `shinobi agent`.
